text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Teio Sho. Through this 
race, Copano Rickey sought to determine 
the right time to compete against Hokko 
Tarumae and the others—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the paddock, looking at Hokko Tarumae, 
Wonder Acute remarked: The current Hokko 
Tarumae is strong—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae is no longer the girl with 
no room to spare back then. And now, their 
true battle is about to begin!
